personas.name: Careless Trendsetters
personas.description: Younger demographic enthusiastic about fashion and trending products despite modest income.
personas.actionable_strategy: Engage with viral social media campaigns, flash discount sales, limited-time trend alerts, and BNPL financing.

personas.name: Frugal Savers
personas.description: High earning potential but cautious spending habits. Rarely impulse buy and seek superior utility.
personas.actionable_strategy: Target with premium product comparisons, quality durability guarantees, luxury bundles, and high-value incentives.

personas.name: VIP Champions
personas.description: Affluent, highly active buyers with superior brand affinity and top-tier lifetime customer value (LTV).
personas.actionable_strategy: Invite to exclusive VIP lounge, early access product drops, white-glove support, and premium tier rewards.

personas.name: Budget Conscious
personas.description: Price-sensitive shoppers with minimal discretionary budget and low purchase frequency.
personas.actionable_strategy: Offer clearance promotions, discount coupons, essential product bundles, and free shipping thresholds.

personas.name: Balanced Mainstream
personas.description: Core demographic with steady income and pragmatic, predictable shopping cycles.
personas.actionable_strategy: Nurture with loyalty points programs, category cross-selling, seasonal newsletters, and milestone anniversary gifts.
